translation.name: Seongsu Cafe & Shopping Walk
translation.summary: A half-day walk through Seongsu combining signature cafes, shopping streets, pop-up culture and industrial-style spaces.
translation.description: This route is designed for first-time visitors who want to experience the modern side of Seongsu in a compact half day. It moves through cafe, shopping and warehouse-style spaces around the neighborhood's main streets.

stops.note: Start with coffee in one of Seongsu's best-known industrial-style cafe spaces.
Walk Yeonmujang-gil and explore side streets, boutiques and current pop-ups.
Take a break at a multi-use cafe and retail space.
Experience Seongsu's warehouse-regeneration style in a large cultural cafe space.
Finish near Seongsu Station with a contemporary footwear and fashion stop.
